content: Lyssa Adkins' Agile Coaching Framework defines 8 core competencies: Agile-Lean Practitioner, Teaching, Mentoring, Professional Coaching, Facilitation, Technical Mastery, Business Mastery, and Transformation Mastery. The coach balances these stances depending on team maturity.

Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF) in SAFe is calculated as Cost of Delay divided by Job Duration. Cost of Delay = User-Business Value + Time Criticality + Risk Reduction / Opportunity Enablement. High WSJF features deliver maximum ROI first.

The 2020 Scrum Guide defines 3 accountabilities: Product Owner (maximizes value), Scrum Master (establishes Scrum & effectiveness), and Developers (creates usable increments). The Scrum team is self-managing with a limit of 10 or fewer people.

T1190 refers to Exploitation of Public-Facing Applications. Attackers leverage vulnerabilities in web servers, databases, or SaaS APIs to gain unauthorized initial access. Mitigations include patch management, WAF implementation, and network segmentation.

Prompt Injection occurs when untrusted user inputs manipulate the LLM's system instructions. Mitigation requires strict input sanitization, architectural segregation between system instructions and data context, and dual-LLM validation.

NIST Zero Trust assumes no implicit trust based on network location. Core tenets include continuous authentication, microsegmentation, policy engine verification, and least privilege access across all enterprise assets.

topic: Edge Small Language Models (SLMs) vs Cloud LLMs
content: Edge SLMs (e.g. Microsoft Phi-3, Gemma 2B) run 4-bit quantized (GGUF/AWQ) on local hardware with sub-100ms latency, zero cloud API costs, and 100% privacy compliance for air-gapped security operations.
